                  Wagin Ram "Baart"

                  One of the Town’s major attractions, "Baart" was built locally in 1985. Thousands of tourists visit the ram annually which is located in the Wetlands Park.

                  Puntapin at night

                  Puntapin Rock is approx. 5 minutes drive south/east of Wagin and is well worth the short drive and the climb to see the fabulous 360 degree views. 

                  Baart under the stars

                  The largest Anatomically correct man made Merino Ram in the known Universe. 

                  Westjets in Wagin

                  Westjets are a regular visitor to Wagin's airstrip and visitors are welcome to attend.

                  Act Belong Commit

                  Check in on someone, send a note, invite them for a cuppa.

                  Council & Committee Meeting Dates

                  The Council holds its ordinary monthly Council Meetings (generally) on the fourth Tuesday of each month except January where no meeting and December where this meeting will be held on the third Tuesday. Meetings are held in the Council Chambers, 2 Arthur Road Wagin and commence at 7.00pm. All meetings are open to the public.

                  Wagin Ram "Baart"

                  One of the Town’s major attractions, "Baart" was built locally in 1985. Thousands of tourists visit the ram annually which is located in the Wetlands Park.

                  Puntapin at night

                  Puntapin Rock is approx. 5 minutes drive south/east of Wagin and is well worth the short drive and the climb to see the fabulous 360 degree views. 

                  Baart under the stars

                  The largest Anatomically correct man made Merino Ram in the known Universe. 

                  Westjets in Wagin

                  Westjets are a regular visitor to Wagin's airstrip and visitors are welcome to attend.

                  Check in on someone, send a note, invite them for a cuppa.

                  Wagin Ram "Baart"

                  One of the Town’s major attractions, "Baart" was built locally in 1985. Thousands of tourists visit the ram annually which is located in the Wetlands Park.

                  Puntapin at night

                  Puntapin Rock is approx. 5 minutes drive south/east of Wagin and is well worth the short drive and the climb to see the fabulous 360 degree views. 

                  Baart under the stars

                  The largest Anatomically correct man made Merino Ram in the known Universe. 

                  Westjets in Wagin

                  Westjets are a regular visitor to Wagin's airstrip and visitors are welcome to attend.

                  Act Belong Commit

                  Check in on someone, send a note, invite them for a cuppa.
